case.inventionTitle: Extruded cookie units having interior designs
case.applicationStatusDescriptionText: Abandoned  --  After Examiner's Answer or Board of Appeals Decision

timeline.message: I've filed a patent application for Extruded cookie units having interior designs.

*(Note: The provided text contains no [+...+] or [-...-] markup indicating claim modifications, so the summary reflects the complete scope of the current claims.)*

The invention is directed to a ready-to-bake coextruded cookie unit and its manufacturing method, featuring first and second doughs of different colors that cooperatively form a continuous design element extending from the top to the bottom surface. Both doughs incorporate a specific shortening with a defined Solid Fat Index at 70°F and utilize a targeted sugar particle size distribution to ensure structural integrity and appearance. The process involves coextruding the doughs into a continuous rope, cutting it into individual units using specialized slicing mechanisms, and packaging them for consumer use.

Based on the review of the claims, there are no insertions (`[+...+]`) or deletions (`[-...-]`) marked in the provided text, meaning all claims remain in their original or newly added state without internal modifications. The invention generally covers ready-to-bake coextruded cookie units made from multiple differently colored doughs containing specific shortening and sugar formulations that define a continuous design element from top to bottom. Additionally, the claims encompass methods for manufacturing these multi-colored, coextruded dough ropes and packaging the resulting units for distribution.
